54061:33872.name: Rich Tooltip
54061:33872.description:
Rich tooltips provide additional context about a UI element. They can optionally contain a subhead, buttons, and hyperlinks.
Rich tooltips are best used for longer text like definitions or explanations.

57994:2264.name: Type=Round, Size=Small, State=Enabled
57994:2264.description:
Standard Icon buttons are low-emphasis buttons.
They are used for the lowest priority actions, especially when presenting multiple options.

Icon buttons can be placed on a variety of backgrounds. Until the button is interacted with, its container isn’t visible.
